CustomField.description: This field indicates whether a fleet directly coordinates service with a vendor. It is connected to the Service Setup in the Geopointe flow, allowing agents to select the "Monitor Only" option to bypass the standard service setup process for fleets. The "Monitor Only" option is available only when this field is "Checked" and the case origin is either Email or Web. When the "Monitor Only" option is "Checked", the PCC does not contact the vendor to arrange the service; instead, they only follow up on the service status.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Does this fleet setup up services directly with the provider, requesting the PCC to only monitor the service, not set it up.
CustomField.label: Monitor Only
